{{Top|leg}}
A '''blood duel''' was part of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] culture. Blood duels were called in the event that there were too many young Ugnaughts vying to enter into a limited number of jobs in one of the traditional [[blood profession]]s such as [[belter]] or [[Tibanna gas panner]]. The blood duel was a series of battles to the [[Death/Legends|death]] as the Ugnaughts fought to claim their right to enter their blood profession.
